function.arguments: {"index": 4, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The channel is not randomly assigned: the email campaign was deliberately targeted at high-value customers (loyal and returning segments), leading to imbalance in `customer_segment` across channels. A raw comparison of conversion rates between channels would confound the campaign effect with segment differences. To isolate the effect of the channel, we computed conversion rates within each `customer_segment` stratum and then computed a weighted average of the differences (email minus paid_search) using the size of each segment as weights. This stratified approach adjusts for the imbalance and provides a valid estimate of the campaign effect."}
function.name: resolve_finding
